# Task Checkpoint Record

> Select the task's private state and exact binding before acting. Use bounded JSON interfaces; pointers retain their source authority.

- [Agent contract](AGENTS.md): repository ownership, validation and public/private boundaries.
- [Specification](SPEC.md): current deliverables and acceptance limits.
- [Record and recall Skill](skills/task-checkpoint-record/SKILL.md): bind a selected task, inspect windows, filter and resolve source-qualified metadata.
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): callback admission, jobs, coverage and model separation.
- [Agent service](docs/agent-service.md): explicit activation, resident supervisor/worker PTC loop, recall, cancellation and finite budgets.
- [Resident runtime](docs/agent-runtime.md): dynamic tool transport, process/thread ownership and observed native receipts.
- [Supervisor contract](docs/agent-supervisor-plan.md): scoped delegation, evidence graph, cached Stop and release acceptance.
- [Helper protocol](docs/helper-protocol.md): explicit bounded process input/output.
- [Installation](docs/installation.md): exact plan/apply/verify/rollback for local CLI and Hook definitions.
- [Unified configuration](docs/configuration.md): one explicit local file for recorder settings, dedicated Codex auth/models, and the selected Jev provider's credential reference.
- [Dedicated authentication](docs/authentication.md): persistent standard device-auth in an isolated Codex home.
- [Model runtime](docs/app-server-runtime.md): explicit prepared-input calls, native identities and lifecycle limits.
- [Distribution](docs/distribution.md): public packages, plugins, CI, containers and version compatibility.
- [Client plugins](docs/client-plugins.md): Codex/Claude Hooks, Claude slash commands, explicit configuration and removal.
- [Adapter roadmap](docs/adapters-roadmap.md): client-specific publication states and Pi package/extension TODO.
- [Implementation plan](docs/implementation-plan.md): phased delivery and later lifecycle work.
- [Engineering lessons](docs/engineering-lessons.md): concrete failure mechanisms and the focused checks that prevent recurrence.
